title: Monsoon Chrome Portrait
desc: A high-impact Indian Gen-Z rainy-season chrome portrait direction for social posts.

Keep the person authentic and natural. Make the final image feel like a high-end Indian fashion campaign designed for Instagram.

title: Founder Reels Hook
desc: A compact strategy prompt to turn one business idea into a scroll-stopping founder reel.
